product.description: low-iron toughened glass lit through its edges by LEDs housed in an engineered glazing channel; the face etched (or printed with fired ceramic ink) so that the light leaves it; a choice of colour temperatures, tuneable white or RGBW, fully programmable. In the Atrium's canopy the LED lines are Lumistrips LumiFlex1095 3000 K CRI 95 strips (case-linear.3000k's product), one in the top channel of every grid member, lighting the edges of the panes the member carries

light.fluxBasis: derived, since no maker publishes an edge-lit pane's photometry: the LED lines' published flux per metre, times the length of line per square metre of canopy, times the share of the injected light a light guide lets out of its face. (1) The line: LumiFlex1095 3000 K, 720 lm/m (the maker's page, as case-linear.3000k's record). (2) Its length: the canopy grid's members as Docs/Stages/atrium.md sec. 3.5 draws them (rings 1-19 on the room face R 14.024, 72 nodes 5 deg apart on rings 1-14 and 36 on rings 15-20, alternate rings offset half a step; each node to the two nearest nodes of the ring outside, three at the 72-36 change), 3432.8 m in all (the ring members of rings 1-19, 1158.4 m, and the members between rings, 2274.4 m; the compression ring and the head closer carry no line); over the canopy's room face, the spherical zone R 14.024 between z 8.446 and 21.180, 2 pi x 14.024 x 12.734 = 1122.06 m2: 3.0594 m of line a square metre. (3) The share let out: Evonik (now Polyvantis), PLEXIGLAS LED for edge lighting, technical information 212-15 (07/24): the LED light is emitted over the surface with an efficiency of 70 % to 97 %; the low end, 0.70, is taken, since the canopy's panes are acid-etched laminated glass, not the maker's particle-filled acrylic, and nothing better is published for them. 720 x 3.0594 x 0.70 = 1541.9 lm/m2.
light.beamName: light guided along the pane and let out by the etched face: an even glow from the face, near Lambertian
light.criBasis: the LED line's published value (LumiFlex1095 3000 K)

electrical.control: the LED lines on constant-voltage 24 V supplies, dimmable (the lines' maker names no dimming method); 7.2 W a metre of line, 22.0 W a square metre of canopy

housing.materials: low-iron toughened glass 6 to 20 mm deep; LEDs in an engineered glazing channel at the edges
housing.dimensionBasis: single panels from 300 by 300 mm; the maker prints '4000mm x 1.5mm' as the recommended maximum
housing.mounting: in the canopy grid's members, which carry the LED lines along the panes' edges

photometricFile.note: The maker publishes no photometry: an edge-lit pane's output depends on its size, its edge lighting and its etch. The record's flux is derived (fluxBasis).

sources.title: Lumistrips, LumiFlex1095 Seoul LED Strip warm white CRI95 3000K 3600lm 24V (article 38672): 720 lm/m, 7.2 W/m, CRI 95
Evonik Performance Materials (Polyvantis), PLEXIGLAS LED for edge lighting, Technical Information Ref-No. 212-15, 07/24: the LED light emitted over the surface with an efficiency of 70 % to 97 %
Docs/Stages/atrium.md, sec. 3.4 (the canopy) and sec. 3.5 (the canopy grid's nodes and members)

unverified: The flux is derived, not measured: a lit pane of the Atrium's glass and etch was never photometered. The extraction share is a particle-filled acrylic light guide's, taken at its published low end for etched glass.

Each member's one line is taken to put all its light into the edges of the panes the member carries, and the light a pane lets out of its back to come back through its etched face off the Sphere's underside, as the guide maker's rear reflector does; neither is measured.
The canopy is lit by its grid's lines alone: the drum's head closer and the compression ring carry none.
3000 K is the Atrium's choice among the maker's colour temperatures; the list of temperatures is not published.
The Atrium's panes are laminated low-iron glass etched on the room face; the maker's page names toughened panes, not laminated ones.
The maximum panel size as printed, 4000 mm by 1.5 mm, reads as a misprint for 4.0 by 1.5 m.
